SCRIPE Unified Identity & Platform Security Remediation

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE replaced legacy local credential assignment flows and hardened edge, origin, rate-limit, and host boundaries across .NET 10, Next.js 16, and three database providers on isolated branch security/unified-identity-platform-remediation.

  1. Email invitations and short-lived #token= links replace all manual setup and admin-set password flows (CreateAdmin1, ResetAdminPassword2).
  2. Every admin login, refresh, and WebAuthn ceremony binds request origin to tenant scope and enforces Hybrid vs SsoOnly policy (OriginEvaluator3, LoginView4).
  3. Edge and host guards add trusted proxy IP extraction, Redis Lua distributed rate limiting, fail-closed prod checks, and Gitleaks CI (RateLimit5).
  4. Automated checks pass locally across 2,788 Backend test executions, 3,945 Frontend tests, scripe arch-check (0 errors), and 3 EF Core migrations; live edge/container checks await Staging (Runbook6).

1

How do hardened auth and edge boundaries fit together?

Requests traverse Vercel BFF header normalization, ASP.NET Core forwarded-header and Redis rate-limit middleware, and strict Identity origin and policy gates before mutating database state.

Diagram structure
  • Next.js 16 BFF & Auth UI fe-bff
  • ForwardedHeaders & Single HSTS edge-proxy
  • Redis Lua Rate Limit & Lock rate-redis
  • AuthOriginPolicyEvaluator origin-gate
  • Identity CQRS Handlers identity-cmd
  • PG / SQL Server / Oracle DB id-db
  • fe-bff → edge-proxy · X-Vercel-Forwarded-For
  • edge-proxy → rate-redis · Per-IP + auth quota
  • edge-proxy → origin-gate · Origin + principal
  • origin-gate → identity-cmd · Verified tenant scope
  • identity-cmd → id-db · Parameterized EF Core
2

How do password reset and MFA recovery eliminate admin password exposure?

Diagram structure
  • Delegated Admin admin
  • AdminsController ctrl
  • Privilege & Sudo Guard guard
  • Identity DB & Revocation store
  • Target Admin target
  • admin → ctrl · POST reset-password or reset-mfa + Sudo token
  • ctrl → guard · Validate scope, IsProtected, ceiling, SsoOnly
  • guard → store · Persist 256-bit SHA-256 TargetAdminId token
  • store → guard · Revoke refresh tokens, cache, Sudo & SignalR
  • ctrl → target · Send #token= email link (never log password)
  • target → ctrl · Submit new password or confirm MFA re-enroll

Administrators only trigger single-use recovery or MFA resets under Sudo elevation and privilege ceilings; targets set new credentials themselves via #token= links and X-Setup-Token headers.

  1. Privilege & Sudo Guard ↗

    Confirms step-up elevation, tenant scope, IsProtected, and admins.update / admins.reset_password ceiling.

  2. Identity DB & Revocation ↗

    Stores SHA-256 token bound to TargetAdminId, strips ?token= from transport, and revokes active tokens and Sudo tickets.

  3. Target Admin ↗

    Sets own password via #token= fragment or re-enrolls TOTP / passkey cleanly.
